title: Op Rollup Jackal Kit
tagline: This project allows rollups made with the OP stack to use the Jackal Protocol as a Data Availability layer!
description: This project allows rollups made with the OP stack to use the Jackal Protocol (https://www.jackalprotocol.com/) as a Data Availability layer. Every block header is posted to Jackal, and the corresponding key is written to chain alongside the data being posted to the Jackal Protocol.
how_its_made: This project is made by creating a new Optimism DA server that follows the KV storage standards to be an active DA server. It then hooks into the Jackal Protocol using a custom message queue to push every block through to the network. To do this we forked celestia's fork of roll-op (https://github.com/0xFableOrg/roll-op) and replaced all the celestia specific items in place of Jackal bindings. Links to our fork are in the readme of the main project.
